definition.name: fidelity
definition.definition: The fidelity between two quantum states rho and sigma is F(rho, sigma) = ||sqrt(rho) sqrt(sigma)||_1^2, where ||.||_1 is the trace norm. For a pure state |psi> and a mixed state rho, this simplifies to F(|psi><psi|, rho) = <psi|rho|psi>. Fidelity ranges from 0 (orthogonal states) to 1 (identical states). Uhlmann's theorem states F(rho, sigma) = max_{|rho_bar>,|sigma_bar>} |<rho_bar|sigma_bar>|^2, where the max is over all purifications.
